project.title: Launch of Seasonal In-Store Food Promotion Corner
project.objective: Plan and execute a seasonal in-store food promotion corner to increase sales and improve customer experience while complying with food safety and visual merchandising standards.
deliverables: Defined product assortment and stock plan for the promotion corner
Visual merchandising layout and display guidelines for the corner
Customer interaction and upsell script for sales assistants
Daily checklist for stock, hygiene, and display compliance
Sales and customer feedback tracking sheet for the promotion period
constraints: Promotion corner must be ready in-store within 21 days
All displayed food items must comply with food safety and hygiene rules
Display must fit within the assigned floor space and existing fixtures
Budget for additional materials and samples is limited
Store opening hours cannot be disrupted during setup and refresh
Assortment must align with current supplier contracts and availability

risks.risk: Insufficient stock levels for promoted items leading to empty displays.
risks.mitigation: Set minimum stock thresholds, monitor daily, and agree fast reorder process with suppliers.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with food safety and hygiene in the promotion corner.
risks.mitigation: Create a clear hygiene checklist, brief all staff, and schedule spot checks by a responsible person.

risks.risk: Promotion corner layout causing congestion or blocking aisles.
risks.mitigation: Validate layout with store manager and adjust placement to respect traffic flow and safety rules.

risks.risk: Customer confusion about promotion pricing or product information.
risks.mitigation: Standardize price labels and provide a simple info sheet and talking points for sales assistants.

risks.risk: Delayed delivery of key promotional items from suppliers.
risks.mitigation: Confirm delivery dates early, identify backup items, and update assortment plan if needed.

themes.why_relevant: Sales assistants must align promoted items with customer demand and ensure stock availability.
The promotion corner must attract customers and follow store layout and branding rules.

themes.theme: Food safety, hygiene, and legal compliance
themes.why_relevant: Handling and displaying food requires strict adherence to hygiene and legal requirements.
Sales assistants need clear scripts and guidance to identify needs and increase basket size.
Consistent execution depends on simple routines for stock, cleanliness, and display checks.

backlog.task: Define the list of seasonal food items and quantities for the promotion corner
definition_of_done: Shortlist of items created based on past sales and customer preferences
Minimum and target stock levels defined per item
List validated with store manager and supply chain coordinator

backlog.task: Create a visual merchandising layout for the promotion corner
definition_of_done: Sketch or simple plan of product placement completed
Hot items and complementary products positioned for cross-sell
Layout reviewed with visual merchandising specialist or store manager

backlog.task: Draft a customer interaction and upsell script for the promotion
definition_of_done: Script covers greeting, needs assessment, product guidance, and upsell suggestions
Key product benefits and allergy or ingredient info included where relevant
Script shared with all sales assistants and feedback collected

backlog.task: Prepare a daily checklist for stock, hygiene, and display compliance
definition_of_done: Checklist includes stock levels, expiry date checks, cleanliness, and signage
Responsibilities and timing for checks clearly assigned
Checklist approved by store manager and food safety officer

backlog.task: Coordinate with suppliers to confirm availability and delivery dates
definition_of_done: Suppliers for each item contacted and availability confirmed
Delivery dates and quantities documented
Risks or gaps identified and backup items proposed

backlog.task: Set up the physical promotion corner in-store
definition_of_done: Shelves and displays cleaned and prepared
Products placed according to the agreed layout
Price labels and promotional signage installed and checked

backlog.task: Define and document hygiene and food safety routines for the corner
definition_of_done: Cleaning frequency and responsible persons defined
Procedures for handling samples or open food documented
Routines validated against store food safety guidelines

backlog.task: Create a simple sales and customer feedback tracking sheet
definition_of_done: Sheet includes daily sales by item and key customer comments
Format is easy to fill during or after shifts
Location and update responsibility agreed with the team

backlog.task: Run a short team briefing on the promotion corner launch
definition_of_done: All sales assistants briefed on assortment, layout, and scripts
Hygiene and safety expectations clearly explained
Open questions captured and clarifications documented

backlog.task: Monitor promotion performance and propose mid-course adjustments
definition_of_done: Weekly review of sales and feedback completed
Underperforming items and stock issues identified
Concrete adjustment proposals shared with store manager

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on promotion scope, target items, and overall objectives.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final list of product categories to include in the promotion corner.
Confirm the sales and customer experience objectives for the promotion period.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the visual layout and operational constraints for the corner.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing the first draft of the layout and asking for feedback on placement and flow.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final visual merchandising layout for the promotion corner.
Decide on the exact location and footprint of the promotion corner in the store.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock customer interaction scripts and hygiene routines.
threads_plan.trigger: Post with draft customer script and hygiene routines asking for quick review and additions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the customer interaction and upsell script to be used by all sales assistants.
Confirm the daily hygiene and food safety routines for the promotion corner.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan the launch date, team briefing, and daily routines.
threads_plan.trigger: Message proposing a go-live date and asking who can cover setup and first briefing.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Set the official launch date and time for the promotion corner.
Assign owners for daily checklist completion and sales tracking updates.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review early performance and agree on adjustments.
threads_plan.trigger: End-of-week message sharing first sales and feedback results from the tracker.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which underperforming items to replace or discount further.
Agree on any changes to layout or scripts based on customer feedback.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in on stock, hygiene, and any issues with the promotion corner.
Twice-weekly quick review of sales and customer feedback in the channel using the tracker.
Pre-launch briefing thread to confirm readiness and responsibilities the day before go-live.
End-of-promotion retrospective thread to capture learnings and ideas for the next campaign.
